instruction: Extract the attachment 'Invoice-14472E82-0009.pdf' from the email in Thunderbird, rename it to 'twitter_invoice_2024.pdf', and save it in the Downloads folder.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting attachment 'Invoice-14472E82-0009.pdf' from Thunderbird email, renaming it to 'twitter_invoice_2024.pdf', and saving to Downloads. Evaluator verifies: (1) renamed file exists at correct path with .pdf extension, (2) file size matches expected attachment size (58198 bytes with 1% tolerance), (3) file content hash matches expected SHA256 hash (842011339fe345ba70ff8acfb1696225cb5a1fcb59dddcbfe6e1b83faff78558), (4) PDF metadata matches expected values (creator: Chromium, producer: Skia/PDF m96), (5) original attachment file does NOT exist in Downloads (STRICTLY enforcing rename operation - fails if original exists). Hash and metadata verification prevent false positives from arbitrary PDFs.
metadata.verification: Verified from Thunderbird profile: email contains Invoice-14472E82-0009.pdf (58198 bytes, SHA256: 842011339fe345ba70ff8acfb1696225cb5a1fcb59dddcbfe6e1b83faff78558). Custom metric verifies: (1) file saved with new name 'twitter_invoice_2024.pdf' matches expected size, (2) file content hash matches expected hash for strong content identity verification, (3) PDF metadata (creator: Chromium, producer: Skia/PDF m96) matches expected values, (4) original file does NOT exist (strictly enforces rename vs copy). Hash and metadata verification ensure only the actual Thunderbird attachment passes, preventing false positives from arbitrary PDFs.
